principles: No v0.26 scientific payload is silently rewritten into v0.27 semantics.
Validation/read compatibility is distinct from resumability.
Every v0.26 schema has one explicit decision and one executable fixture.
Frozen Gate2 oracle records are immutable reference evidence and are never migrated in place.
Unknown schema IDs, unknown envelope major versions, unknown unversioned JSON, and malformed JSON fail closed.
Operational current-state snapshots never acquire fresh liveness by migration; liveness must be refreshed from runtime.
Candidate v0.27 source is not promoted by this specification; DEL-001 remains the semantic integration gate.
